text:
We checked “TTC Font Template” and found 2 issues in the InDesign file that are likely causing the problems in Frontify. Here’s what to change:

1. Font missing from the package
Frontify needs the font files to render the text, otherwise the template falls back to another font.
Where: the font “Futura”
• Make sure the font is installed or activated on your computer.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Fonts" checked, and zip the whole folder, including "Document fonts".
Learn more

2. Unsupported font format
Frontify can only use OpenType (.otf) and TrueType (.ttf) fonts.
Where: the font “Futura.ttc”
• Get an OTF or TTF version from the font vendor and swap it in with Type > Find/Replace Font.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
